The '''Calaron sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the Calaron included [[Akrit'tar/Legends|Akrit'tar]], [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]], [[F'tral]], [[Fwillsving]], [[Jerijador]], [[Koozebane]], [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]], [[Morvogodine]], [[Darvannis]], and [[Norval II]].

==History==
In the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], the Calaron sector was part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Calaron sector was created for the computer game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], which placed ten planets in the sector; however, ''Rebellion'' made numerous errors in its cartographic placement. As such, [[Leland Chee]], [[Holocron continuity database|Keeper of the Holocron]], has stated that when its placements conflict with existing [[canon]] placements, they are overridden.<ref name="Tasty">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=118855&start=15#3897382|thread=Galaxy Map Discussion|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2003-05-01|time=1:40 PM}}</ref> In the case of the Calaron sector, this applies to several planets, including [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. Kessel has been placed in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]],<ref name="The Hutt Gambit">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> and Ithor has been placed in the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]].
